_comment: Single source of truth for the card catalogue, shared by config.sh (bash) and quota.py (python).
Both quota metrics are load-bearing. us-central1 grants 16 PREEMPTIBLE_NVIDIA_A100_GPUS but only
12 A2_CPUS -- i.e. exactly ONE a2-highgpu-1g. A preflight that checked the GPU metric alone would
promise 16 concurrent A100 jobs and deliver 1.
Prices are public LIST prices captured 2026-09-15 for us-central1: an estimate for the cost line,
not an invoice. Spot prices float; reconcile against billing for anything that matters.
prices_note: public list price, us-central1, whole-VM USD/hour; estimate, not an invoice

l4.note: iteration card. 2 of 8 are held by another team's running instances in us-central1.

a100-40.note: THE TRAINING PATH, on spot. On-demand quota is 1 and is already consumed by another team.

a100-80.note: QUOTA IS ZERO IN THIS PROJECT AND NOT YET REQUESTED. Present so the preflight can refuse it by name. 80 GB A100s ARE free at point of use on CSF3 -- design for CSF3, not for this.

unavailable.h100: not offered to this project in us-central1 or europe-west4
unavailable.h200: not offered to this project in us-central1 or europe-west4
